svg.title: FinAware — Three Ways to Run It
svg.text: FinAware — Three Ways to Run It

The same parts (the web app, nine Node.js services and the Python ML service) run as processes on one computer, as containers with Docker Compose, or as pods on Kubernetes. Only the packaging and the addresses change.
One computer — 11 processes, started together by concurrently
Compose network — containers reach each other by name (http://auth:4101 …)
Namespace finaware — one Deployment and one Service per part
Hot reload: page and component edits show at once.
Python 3.12 or newer; set up with npm run ml:setup
Node 20 (.nvmrc). The README walks through the whole setup, step by step.
Services run with tsx services/<name>/src/server.ts and have no hot reload: restart the stack after editing services/
Trains the risk model and the peer groups while the image is built (ALLOW_PROPOSED_TARGET=1 until the supervisor
approves the risk target); runs as a non-root user; health check /health/ready.
The missed-payment model needs the app database to train, so this image has none: POST /predict/payment-miss answers
Mounted in db-init, web and every
Creates the tables in the volume. Every Node container
waits for it to finish first.
Settings come from the .env file (OPENAI_API_KEY is optional).
the web app and all nine Node services
TLS certificate from cert-manager: Let's Encrypt staging for dev, production for stag and prod.
Only the web app is exposed; every other part is an internal ClusterIP Service.
2 replicas; in prod a HorizontalPodAutoscaler keeps 2–5 pods at 70% CPU
NetworkPolicy: only financial-api pods may connect to it.
ConfigMap: environment, model name, WhatsApp numbers, cookie
values-prod.yaml points DATABASE_URL at Postgres so several
pods can share it, but prisma/schema.prisma is still SQLite:
production needs the Prisma provider switched and a migration first.
Checks before a push — run them locally (the GitHub Actions CI workflow is paused)
npm test · npm run lint · npm run typecheck · npm run ml:test
FinAware · Three Ways to Run It · drawn from the code · updated 29 September 2026
